finalLens.title: Before the Next Voice
finalLens.intro: The work is already moving, yet you quickly point to the next pair of hands.
finalLens.pull_quote: I can get everyone looking at the same thing, but I still need to leave room for the next voice.
finalLens.deeper_read: A meeting reaches the point where everyone understands the work, and you are ready to give it shape: who takes it next, what good looks like, when it goes out. That clarity helps the work travel, as long as the room is not filled before someone else can add to it.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for the moment you answer the next question before a quieter colleague has finished considering it.
finalLens.move: After naming who takes it next, wait through one full beat before adding anything else.

finalLens.pull_quote: I can keep doing this, but I cannot pretend that part is working.

finalLens.watch_for: Notice whether you redo the same part after following the routine exactly as you usually do.
finalLens.move: Before changing the whole routine, move that one step earlier or later for today.
